title: PROPOSED — Mnemo multilingual diagnostic failure taxonomy v2

message.description: Sanitized diagnostic only; no source text, secret, filesystem path, storage URI or unauthorized identifier.

x-mnemo-classification-rules.CORPUS_ABSENT: Permitted only when immutable source-census and authorized evidence-census predicates both prove absence; never inferred from an empty ranking.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.CORPUS_PRESENT_UNDETECTED: Requires positive corpus/evidence presence and no qualifying observation.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.CORPUS_PRESENT_WRONG_LANGUAGE: Requires authoritative metadata or adjudicated evidence contradicting the observation.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.RERANKER_INPUT_INVALID: Includes blank semantic text, title-only substitution, caller-invented text, missing lineage, incompatible representation or preprocessing mismatch.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.AUTHORIZATION_FILTERED: A security result, never evidence that corpus or language is absent.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.QUERY_UNGROUNDED: Routing/behavioral use only; excluded from semantic quality metrics.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.QREL_INVALID: Evaluation defect; never reclassified as retrieval or language failure.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.CAPABILITY_ADVERTISEMENT_INCONSISTENT: Advertised state disagrees with the Phase85RuntimeV1-derived readiness record.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.PRINCIPAL_MISSING: No server-derived authenticated PrincipalContextV1 exists; enumeration is forbidden.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.RETRIEVAL_SCOPE_UNAUTHORIZED: The requested RetrievalScopeV2 exceeds the bounded decision.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.POSITIONAL_SCOPE_UNAUTHORIZED: The requested PositionalScopeV2 exceeds the bounded decision.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.ACTIVE_V2_ALIAS_MISSING: No governed active V2 alias set was resolved.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.ACTIVE_V2_GENERATION_MISMATCH: Resolved V2 generations differ from the active alias or are not complete and ready.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.PROFILE_MISMATCH: A profile, database, build run, or provider identity conflicts with the active governed binding.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.AUTHORIZATION_DECISION_STALE: A current authoritative binding differs from the decision binding; enumeration is forbidden.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.REPRESENTATION_LINEAGE_MISSING: Derived evidence lacks required governed representation or transformation lineage.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.EVIDENCE_OUTSIDE_AUTHORIZED_SCOPE: A reference is outside the bounded authorized retrieval or positional scope.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.SEMANTIC_EVIDENCE_MISSING: The authorized evidence resolver found no semantic evidence.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.SEMANTIC_EVIDENCE_BLANK: The authorized evidence resolver found only blank semantic evidence.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.TITLE_ONLY_EVIDENCE: Title metadata was presented as semantic evidence; candidate construction is forbidden.
x-mnemo-classification-rules.V1_EVIDENCE_IN_V2_PATH: V1 evidence was supplied to an active V2-only runtime path; cross-space fallback is forbidden.
